crossApp.name: reference-palette-distance

notes: Scope: screen step, one sample per app. Every path is under showcase/runs/graphite-blueprint/1.1.0-rc.7/<app>/20261018-022713/ unless it says otherwise. All gates pass in all four apps (eval-1.md). Palette consistency is 0.969, type consistency 0.82, reference palette distance 0.18. With one sample, a tracked item counts as FIXED when this sample shows it fixed. A new flaw in one app is a one-off for now ('1 of 1'). It can only be called recurring after the confirm samples, unless the spec causes it. Desktop captures are 1440 px wide at 1x, so their pixels are CSS px. Mobile captures are 780 px wide at 2x.

Payment: the card ends at 739 and its description at about 744, and the rule is at 792, so 48 px under the taller column (settings/screenshots/settings-billing-desktop-light.png). Security: 'Update password' ends at 614 and the rule is at 663, 49 px (settings/screenshots/state-password-mismatch-desktop-dark.png). R2, plate kinds repeating in grid columns: FIXED for columns. Commerce at 4 columns: column 1 is perspective, wave, lattice. Column 2 is sphere, bars, wave. Column 3 is dot matrix, rings, bars. Column 4 is lattice, fan. No column repeats (commerce/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png). At 3 columns (1,4,7,10 / 2,5,8,11 / 3,6,9) and at 2 columns (odd and even items) I checked the order by hand: no column repeats either. Blog grid: perspective, rings, dot matrix over fan, wave, sphere, and the featured plate is bars, so no repeats (blog/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png). Residual, caused by the spec and minor: with the second pass offset by 3, items 10 and 11 reuse the kinds of items 5 and 6 one column to the right, so wave and bars each step diagonally from row 2 to row 3. This will look the same in every sample, because specKinds is deterministic. The reference's thumbnail row has no echo (pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png, changelog row). The score is not lowered for it. An optional fix is listed.

Reference fidelity (4): the reference's language without copying it. A near-black ground with a paper light mode, inverse pills, tight Inter, mono uppercase captions, 48px split openers, two-tone display closings over the dot field, hairline grids of generative plates, and the teal current column on a quiet stage (commerce/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png, dashboard/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png vs pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png). Not a 5: the blueprints are clean single outlines with a dot core. The reference stack has ribbed tiers and an inner sliced disc (blog/drawings/about-d1.png vs pipeline/linear-study/reference/illustrations/p1-i5.png).

Cross-app consistency (4): one family. Screen heads are a mono eyebrow, h1 and two-tone summary. Apps use '01 / 03' section heads, banners sit above the actions, counts are mono, pins are right-aligned, and the section-current pill looks the same in all three apps that have detail routes. Type consistency is 0.82.

Hierarchy (4): masthead, then the featured plate in the first viewport, then the grid. App screens read head, KPIs, chart and activity, then table. Articles read title, meta, lead plate, body, with the contents as a rail. The about figure row with no opener (V2) is the one soft spot, and published 1.0.0 had it too.

Spacing rhythm (4): the gap the last four iterations targeted is now 48 to 50 px on every settings group, desktop and mobile (R1). Opener to prose is about 55 px, columns end together and table rows are equal. Not a 5: only one sample so far, and the payment group measures 53 px from the card itself because the left description is taller. That is correct under the rule, but it reads slightly loose.

Component states (4): focus is an indigo ring layered over the red error border. Inline errors sit under each field, and an 'n fields need attention' banner sits directly above the actions (settings/screenshots/state-profile-errors-desktop-dark.png, state-password-mismatch-desktop-dark.png with the 'Strength: Strong' dot meter, commerce/screenshots/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png). The empty filter shows a dot glyph, 'NO RESULTS', a line and 'Clear filters', with the focused search ringed (dashboard/screenshots/state-empty-filter-desktop-dark.png). The plan dialog has a mono 'CHANGE PLAN' (settings/screenshots/state-plan-dialog-desktop-dark.png). Not a 5: no pending state could be captured (harness gap).
Polish (4): R3 and R4 are fixed and earlier polish items hold. No default-browser leftovers. The remaining nits are one-offs: V1 echo, V4 repeated facts.

Signature (4): every element is in all four apps, placed as Applying the concept says. Fact-captioned plates in the commerce and blog grids, lead plates, product and project detail on quiet stages. The about row of three at about 276 px, with a marching pair. Tier slabs on plan cards, dot meters on team and password, the empty dot glyph, the chart on a quiet stage, and dot-field closings. Chart-in runs 420 ms on cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94): the columns rise from the base and the teal OCT column lands with the rest by about 485 ms (dashboard/motion/motion-m1.png). Not a 5: blueprint craft is below p1-i5, and the residual diagonal kind echo (R2 note).

promptFixes: Optional, minor, caused by the spec (R2 residual, signature not lowered): in specKinds, offset later passes so a kind never lands diagonally adjacent to its earlier use either. For example, offset by 5 instead of 3, or reverse the order on odd passes. Then add to the Limits line 'nor in a diagonally adjacent cell'. Evidence: commerce/20261018-022713/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png, where wave goes from row 2 column 1 to row 3 column 2 and bars from row 2 column 2 to row 3 column 3, vs the non-repeating reference changelog row in pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png. Check every offset at 2, 3 and 4 columns for 11 to 16 items before choosing.

Optional, clarifying, to apply only if the confirm samples repeat it (V2, 2 of 4 samples across rc.6 and rc.7, also in published 1.0.0): in Signature 3 → Where, change 'a row of three captioned blueprints opening a section' to 'a row of three captioned blueprints directly under its own section opener (h2 and description), never trailing another section's prose'. Evidence: blog/20261018-022713/screenshots/about-desktop-dark.png (FIG row under the 'Why we write' prose) vs rc.6 s1/s2, which had a 'How a post gets made' opener.
